acceptance.criterion: Checkout return alone never grants access; one customer cannot acquire duplicate active paid subscriptions through retries
acceptance.expected: Provider snapshot is authoritative for entitlement, never a client-supplied return; a customer holding any nonterminal subscription cannot start a second checkout, and duplicate nonterminal subscriptions reported by the provider fail closed rather than picking one
acceptance.observed: Checkout() blocks a second attempt while one nonterminal subscription exists and returns the same session on retry (TestCheckoutSurvivesRestartAndPreventsSecondPlan). ReconcileCustomer rejects two nonterminal subscriptions for one customer without granting access or corrupting the account's plan (TestReconcileRejectsDuplicateNonterminalSubscriptions, added this pass) Coordinator regression now inserts reconciliation between initial checkout and fresh-Service retry. It failed before 874dd90 because empty subscription lists erased an open attempt. The corrected path retains it, rejects a different plan, and reuses the original session without a second creation.

acceptance.criterion: Checkout completed before webhook then deletion cancels that subscription; open checkout cannot leave a live subscription after deletion closure is certified
acceptance.expected: CloseBillingAccount expires open checkout sessions, cancels every provider subscription including ones never observed locally, and only certifies closed after a re-list confirms none remain active; a resumed call after partial success stays idempotent
acceptance.observed: TestReconcileCustomerAndCloseBillingAccount confirms session expiry, subscription cancellation and the post-cancel recheck before CloseStatusClosed. TestCloseBillingAccountResumesAfterAlreadyClosedProviderState (added this pass) confirms a second call against already-terminal provider state, with a stale local checkout row left over as if a prior local commit never landed, still certifies closed and clears the stale row TestCloseBillingRetriesAfterProviderSuccessAndLocalCommitFailure now injects an actual SQLite transaction abort after successful provider cancellation, asserts pending and rollback, then retries through a fresh Service and proves local cancellation/free plan with exactly one provider cancellation. Known-session expiration now checks matching ID and expired status. A real provider-success/local-session-save-failure fixture reproduced false closure; corrected behavior retains the unknown attempt and returns pending. Automatic unknown-session resolution is not implemented, so full resumable closure remains unqualified.

acceptance.criterion: Stale checkout attempts are repaired account-scoped and auditable; late webhooks are idempotently acknowledged
acceptance.expected: Attempts older than 23h are resolved or fail closed with an audit_log entry; webhooks for a deleted account acknowledge without creating entitlement; duplicate event IDs are not refetched
acceptance.observed: Known-session old-attempt fixtures prove confirmed expiration removes the attempt with one audit, while open/completed/wrong-ID expiration responses retain it without a success audit. Empty-ID attempts now remain ambiguous rather than being dropped due to age. Automatic resolution of these attempts and the complete late-deletion event matrix remain unqualified; existing duplicate-event tests cover a subset.

acceptance.criterion: Grace deadline is stable under delayed/replayed events, first observed past_due, missed activation, new invoice/renewal and delayed old failure after payment. Renewal opens a fresh allowance while retaining old-window accounting history
acceptance.expected: The 72h payment-failure grace anchors to an authoritative provider timestamp, never local processing time, so delayed delivery or a delayed reconcile cannot silently extend or misplace it; a renewal into a new unpaid period starts a fresh deadline while the closed window's accounting is retained, not overwritten in place
acceptance.observed: Coordinator source review rejects the timestamp semantics: subscription period start need not equal payment failure, and an old event can trigger a fetch of a newer past_due snapshot. Webhook event.created then does not identify that current failure. The paths can produce different initial deadlines depending on arrival order. Existing passing fixtures encode the disputed anchors and do not prove this full criterion. Invoice-bound failure identity and durable timing evidence remain required. Executed delivery-order reproducer on ba90538 yielded September14 versus September4 for the same provider state. Its source is retained separately as an explicitly failing qualification reproducer; the21 default tests do not include it.
